Despite the difficult circumstances, New Zealand managed to score 368 runs on a flattened pitch before a resilient batting effort by Daryl Mitchell and Glenn Phillips blocked India for nearly two sessions on the final day. Latham, who recorded a pair of ducks after being dismissed by Jasprith Bumrah in the first over of both innings, praised the squad for sticking to their plans.

While New Zealand slipped to third in the World Test Championship (WTC) standings behind South Africa and Australia following the match, Latham emphasized that draws remain vital across a two-year cycle. Having more remaining games than most opponents, New Zealand hopes to secure a spot in the June final at The Oval. The team's upcoming fixtures include the second India Test in Christchurch, a tour of Australia, and a home series against Sri Lanka.

stories.title: Baluchistan Wheels Partners with Reon Energy for Hub Solar Plant
stories.summary:
Baluchistan Wheels Limited announced an agreement with Reon Energy Limited to supply and erect a 1 megawatt-peak solar photovoltaic system at its manufacturing facility in Hub, Balochistan. The listed company formally disclosed the development in a notice submitted to the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Monday. Power generation from the newly planned clean energy project is scheduled to commence in April 2027.

Incorporated in 1980 as a public limited company with technical collaboration from the United Kingdom's GKN Sankey Limited, Baluchistan Wheels manufactures automotive wheel rims for buses, cars, trucks, tractors, and mini-commercial vehicles. The company possesses an annual production capacity of approximately 2.5 million wheels. However, future operations face potential headwinds from supply chain disruptions driven by the Middle East crisis, higher fuel prices, and a reversal of the monetary easing cycle that could impact auto sales.

Solar photovoltaic technology is expanding rapidly as an affordable and environmentally friendly method for generating electricity globally and within Pakistan. Total installed solar PV capacity across Pakistan reached 33 gigawatts by October 2025, with the market projected to grow at a Compound Annual Growth Rate of 2.5% from 2022 to 2027.

stories.title: Pakistan Issues Tender to Import Additional Wheat to Stabilise Prices
stories.summary:
Pakistan has resolved to import an additional 800,000 metric tonnes of wheat to build up national reserves, guarantee uninterrupted supplies, and stabilise domestic flour prices. As part of this effort, the Trading Corporation of Pakistan released its third international tender for wheat imports, setting November 30 as the deadline for bid submissions. The country has already secured agreements to import 550,000 metric tonnes of wheat.

These measures coincide with ongoing government initiatives to address a domestic wheat shortage. A recent shipment carrying 58,488 metric tonnes of imported wheat aboard the vessel MV Caravus arrived from Romania and berthed at berths 14 and 15 of the Karachi Gateway Terminal, serving Karachi and other areas in Sindh. This arrival represents the third imported wheat shipment received at the KGT terminal.

Including previous deliveries, the Trading Corporation of Pakistan has successfully imported more than 160,000 tonnes of wheat transported across three vessels. Two bulk carriers carrying over 100,000 metric tonnes of wheat are currently stationed at Karachi Port to fulfill national requirements.

stories.title: Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah Meets Narendra Modi in India
stories.summary:
Nepal’s Prime Minister Balendra Shah traveled to New Delhi for his first international visit since taking office, meeting with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi to discuss bilateral economic and energy ties. The 36-year-old Nepalese leader, who rose to power following youth-led anti-corruption protests in September 2025, received a military honor guard parade at the presidential palace. His trip follows an initial overseas journey to New York in September to address the United Nations General Assembly.

The visit aims to strengthen connections between Kathmandu and New Delhi, focusing heavily on trade, transit commerce, and energy cooperation. India remains Nepal's principal trading partner, accounting for more than 60 percent of imports worth $8.6 billion, whereas China represents 13 percent or $1.8 billion, according to World Bank data. Prior to meeting Modi, Shah held discussions with Indian Foreign Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar.

Shah's government is currently dealing with the aftermath of a catastrophic, tsunami-like glacial mountain collapse in Nepal that claimed over 1,400 lives and left 5,000 individuals missing. Although the rural Himalayan nation contributes minimally to global greenhouse gas emissions, national reconstruction expenses are estimated at $4.78 billion.

The diplomatic engagement is significant as Nepal continually navigates its geopolitical positioning between its two massive neighbors, India and China. Prime Minister Shah arrived in India on Sunday, marking a departure from past Nepalese leaders by holding off on traditional immediate visits to neighboring states until now.

stories.title: Portuguese Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel Visits Pakistan to Strengthen Relations
stories.summary:
Portuguese Minister of State and Foreign Affairs Paulo Rangel traveled to Islamabad for a two-day official visit, meeting with Pakistan's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar. The discussions centered on celebrating 77 years of diplomatic relations and enhancing bilateral cooperation across multiple sectors, including trade, investment, renewable energy, and information technology.

During their meeting at the Foreign Office, DPM Dar emphasized the necessity of increased parliamentary exchanges, regular diplomatic consultations, and enhanced bilateral mechanisms. In response, Rangel reaffirmed Portugal's dedication to strengthening ties, expressed gratitude for Pakistan's support at the United Nations, and acknowledged the positive influence of the Pakistani diaspora living in Portugal.

In addition to bilateral matters, the two officials evaluated regional developments and explored joint cooperation initiatives within the United Nations and European Union frameworks. Rangel praised Pakistan's diplomatic role in supporting global peace efforts, specifically highlighting Islamabad's contributions amid recent regional tensions.

Accompanied by a business delegation, Rangel's itinerary includes participation in the inaugural Pakistan-Portugal Business Forum. Companies from both nations are scheduled to conduct business-to-business meetings to explore commercial partnerships in areas such as agri-food, renewable energy, pharmaceuticals, and textiles.

stories.title: Portuguese Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel Lauds Pakistan's Global Peace Efforts
stories.summary:
Portuguese Minister of State and Foreign Affairs Paulo Rangel stated that Pakistan plays a decisive role in international peace. Speaking informally to state-run television during his arrival in Islamabad, Rangel noted that the global community counts on Islamabad to assist in conflict resolution and foster prosperity, pointing to recent diplomatic efforts regarding dialogue between the United States and Iran.

Rangel landed in Pakistan for a two-day official visit spanning November 22 to 23, following an invitation from Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar. Upon his arrival at the airport, the Portuguese minister was welcomed by Additional Secretary Europe Ambassador Ayesha Ali.

Following his arrival, Rangel engaged in delegation-level talks with Dar at the Foreign Office. The comprehensive agenda included reviewing bilateral relations, increasing trade and investment, and expanding cooperation in agriculture, education, maritime connectivity, and renewable energy, with a particular focus on olive cultivation and processing.

As part of his itinerary, Rangel is joined by a business delegation participating in the inaugural Pakistan-Portugal Business Forum. The event serves as a platform for fostering commercial partnerships and identifying fresh areas for economic cooperation between the two nations.

stories.title: Russian Air Strikes Kill at Least 15 People in Kyiv Region
stories.summary:
Russian military strikes across the Kyiv region resulted in at least 15 fatalities, prompting urgent rescue operations to locate survivors trapped under rubble. The deadly aerial barrages come as Ukraine confronts freezing temperatures and manages the fifth year of the ongoing full-scale Russian invasion, with Moscow intensifying nightly attacks on the country's infrastructure.

An overnight strike in Dymer, situated roughly 45 kilometers north of Kyiv, partially destroyed a five-story residential building and killed at least 11 people, including a teenager and a woman in her forties. Regional official Tymur Tkachenko and state emergency services confirmed the rising death toll while rescuers pulled several survivors, such as a 79-year-old woman and a child, from the debris.

Additional attacks caused casualties elsewhere in the region. A separate strike on a supermarket in Vyshneve killed three individuals and wounded 15 others, including three children. Another strike targeted a private residence in Bila Tserkva, killing one person and destroying the home by fire, while a power substation in the Dnipropetrovsk region was also hit.

The renewed bombardment follows Russian President Vladimir Putin's vow to deliver a painful response to Ukrainian attacks on the Crimea bridge. Those remarks followed a high-level summit between Putin, US President Donald Trump, and Chinese leader Xi Jinping, which has heightened concerns among European nations regarding potential sweeping decisions on the conflict.

stories.title: Peshawar High Court Hears 21 Missing Persons Cases
stories.summary:
The Peshawar High Court recently addressed 21 cases involving disappeared persons, requesting status reports on 15 missing person petitions during Monday's session. A judicial bench led by Justice Ijaz Anwar returned six of the petitions to the respective applicants.

During the proceedings, a petitioner informed the court that her son-in-law had vanished without a trace. When the bench inquired if he had traveled abroad, the plaintiff confirmed he had been employed in Saudi Arabia. Justice Anwar offered procedural relief to the family, noting that because they were traveling from Waziristan, future hearings could be conducted via video link to ease their burden.

In a previous hearing on Monday, the Chief Justice of the Peshawar High Court, S.M. Ateeq Shah, directed local police to submit an official report within 14 days regarding the alleged disappearance of a Russian national named Ali Glegov. The petitioner's legal counsel stated that Glegov had arrived in Islamabad before traveling to Peshawar, where he went missing after meeting friends he connected with on social media.

The court subsequently ordered law enforcement to produce the complete case report and furnish call detail record data for further analysis. These ongoing judicial reviews highlight the high court's active involvement in addressing unresolved disappearance cases within Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

The matter continues to draw public attention as families seek accountability and information regarding their missing relatives from the relevant authorities.

stories.title: India Cricket Captain Shubman Gill Urges Lifting Saliva Ban
stories.summary:
India cricket captain Shubman Gill has publicly advocated for lifting the prohibition on using saliva to polish match balls. His remarks followed a drawn Test match against New Zealand that took place on a notably lifeless pitch in Wellington.

The contest yielded a total of 1,327 runs while producing only 24 wickets across five full days of action. India notably recorded 720-9, which stands as the highest innings score in a Test match in New Zealand. The Basin Reserve pitch, traditionally known for pace and bounce, flattened out significantly by the second morning of the fixture.

Gill emphasized that maintaining the condition of the ball becomes extremely difficult on flat surfaces without the use of saliva, a rule originally implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic. He argued that the sport has moved past those circumstances and that bowlers face severe disadvantages when balls soften quickly and lose their shape. New Zealand captain Tom Latham agreed that the match ball tended to soften rapidly after the first day, though he expressed uncertainty regarding whether global cricket authorities would alter the existing regulations.

Both captains acknowledged that maintaining the ball and generating swing has become a persistent challenge in recent seasons, a problem worsened in Wellington by a dry and slow surface resulting from hampered pitch preparation. Both teams will now travel to Christchurch for the second and deciding Test match, where traditional green and seamer-friendly conditions are anticipated.

stories.title: Federal Government Weighs Two-Month Extension for KP Governor's Rule
stories.summary:
Authorities have initiated formal consultations regarding a potential two-month extension of Governor's Rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as the initial period approaches its conclusion. Provincial authorities are currently drafting recommendations to submit to the federal government, while also evaluating whether to maintain concurrent states of emergency in specific districts.

Governor's Rule was originally imposed on October 11, 2026, and officially ratified for a two-month term on October 16, with an expiration date set for December 11, 2026. Extending the measure for an additional two months necessitates a formal resolution passed during a joint session of Parliament. Constitutional guidelines dictate that Governor's Rule cannot exceed a total duration of six months, capping the maximum possible timeframe in the province at April 11, 2027.

Alongside the provincial governance measures, an emergency was previously declared across eight former tribal districts and four settled districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Officials are currently reviewing the necessity of keeping these emergency protocols active in those specific areas alongside the broader provincial administration decisions.

The federal administration originally invoked Governor's Rule and local emergencies under Articles 232 and 234 of the Constitution of Pakistan. These steps were taken amid mounting political friction with the provincial government led by the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf, driven largely by disagreements over regional security strategies and counterterrorism measures.

stories.title: UN Climate Talks in Antalya Collapse After Rejection of Final Deal
stories.summary:
United Nations climate negotiations concluded in Antalya, Turkey, without a formal agreement after the European Union and several other delegations rejected the final text presented by COP31 presidents Turkey and Australia. The breakdown underscores ongoing global difficulties in securing ambitious commitments to combat escalating climate impacts, such as severe heatwaves, floods, and wildfires, amid competing international pressures.

The summit extended two days past its scheduled conclusion into overtime, making it the longest COP event on record before ultimately failing to secure consensus. Conference president Murat Kurum expressed deep frustration during the closing plenary, stating that all possible efforts were exhausted and declining to present a revised text. Australian COP31 negotiation president Chris Bowen echoed the sentiment, identifying deep divisions over fossil fuels and climate funding as major roadblocks.

The proposed agreement drew fierce criticism from European nations, including Ireland, because it omitted any reference to phasing out fossil fuels. Conversely, major oil-producing nations like Saudi Arabia lobbied successfully to keep fossil fuel transitions out of the text while supporting language centered on carbon-removal technologies and addressing global temperature overshoot. Developing nations also voiced strong objections, arguing that the deal failed to provide adequate financial support to help vulnerable regions adapt to rising temperatures.

Despite the failure to adopt a political declaration in Turkey, participating officials emphasized that previous international climate obligations under the Paris Agreement remain fully intact. Analysts noted that while the setback disrupts multilateral coordination, past COP frameworks have successfully driven renewable energy adoption and influenced long-term global emissions projections.

stories.title: Asian Development Bank Invests in Pakistani B2B Fintech Startup Neem
stories.summary:
The Asian Development Bank announced an investment of an undisclosed amount in Neem, a business-to-business fintech enterprise operating in Pakistan. The funding was executed through ADB Ventures, the lending agency's venture capital division, and is designated to drive product development, expand personnel, and accelerate the onboarding of merchants and enterprises nationwide.

Pakistan has experienced significant advancements in digitizing consumer transactions through mobile wallets and the State Bank of Pakistan's Raast instant payment system. However, commercial transactions continue to lag, with an estimated 71 per cent of retail transaction value still settled through physical cash. Companies striving to digitize often encounter slow, expensive, and fragmented processes when integrating separately with financial institutions and payroll tools.

Neem seeks to bridge this gap by providing companies with a unified platform combining collections, disbursements, programmable ledgers, and financial workflows. The API-first architecture integrates directly with existing operating systems to automate reconciliation and settlement in real time. The startup currently supports more than 70 enterprise clients across retail, logistics, utilities, and manufacturing sectors.

Beyond direct corporate benefits, the initiative aims to draw suppliers, small merchants, and gig workers into the formal financial ecosystem. Neem also extends earned wage access to blue-collar employees, reducing reliance on informal borrowing. Emma Fan, the ADB Country Director for Pakistan, noted that the collaboration helps enterprises transition toward more transparent and manageable payment solutions.

stories.title: South African Rand Rises as US Dollar Weakens and Commodities Climb
stories.summary:
The South African rand strengthened during early trading hours, bolstered by rising commodity prices and a retreating US dollar. The currency climbed roughly 0.9 percent against the dollar to trade at 17.4325 as of 0634 GMT. The greenback faced downward pressure following remarks made by a Federal Reserve official regarding monetary policy.

The softer dollar performance came after Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook expressed concern over current inflation levels on Friday. Cook argued that the central bank's prevailing policy rate was not restrictive enough to adequately curb inflation, making a case for potential future rate hikes.

Meanwhile, key South African exports found renewed support on global markets. Gold recovered some ground after hitting a 14-month low the previous week, while platinum recorded a 1.2 percent increase. Market analysts pointed to upcoming domestic and international data releases as crucial factors for future currency movements.

Adam Phillips, a treasury specialist at Umkhulu Treasury, highlighted that the upcoming release of US PCE inflation data would heavily influence the US dollar. Additionally, South Africa's benchmark 2035 government bond demonstrated strength in early trading, with its yield dropping by 7.5 basis points to reach 8.63 percent.

stories.title: SECP Registers Two New REIT Schemes to Expand Real Estate Market
stories.summary:
The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan has officially registered two new Real Estate Investment Trust schemes, named ATMT Dual REIT Series 1 and the Imperium Tower REIT Scheme. This regulatory addition brings the nation's total number of registered REIT schemes to 31.

According to the official announcement, ATMT Dual REIT Series 1 operates as a hybrid scheme situated in Islamabad that incorporates both rental income and property development. Conversely, the Imperium Tower REIT Scheme is structured as a rental scheme targeting commercial real estate in Lahore through a Special Purpose Vehicle.

With these latest registrations, Pakistan's REIT landscape now encompasses 43 licensed REIT Management Companies alongside the 31 registered schemes. Among these offerings, 21 are Shariah-compliant and seven are officially listed on the stock exchange. Total assets within the sector reached Rs275.85 billion as of September 30, 2026.

Dr Kabir Ahmed Sidhu, Chairman of the SECP, emphasized that REIT schemes serve as an efficient mechanism for delivering organized investments and expanding opportunities within the real estate sector. He reaffirmed the commission's dedication to supporting market growth through regulatory frameworks focused on transparency, robust governance, and investor protection.

stories.title: Security Guard Killed as Armed Robbers Raid Kohat Toll Plaza
stories.summary:
A private security guard lost his life during a violent robbery at the Kohat Tunnel Toll Plaza on the Indus Highway in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. A group of armed suspects targeted the toll collection point to seize cash stored on the premises, prompting an immediate resistance from on-duty security personnel.

The confrontation escalated into an intense exchange of gunfire between the guards and the attackers. During the shootout, a private security guard named Ubaidullah suffered critical bullet wounds and subsequently died from his injuries. The armed perpetrators managed to escape from the scene carrying the looted cash.

Law enforcement authorities responded swiftly, deploying a heavy contingent of police officers to the location to gather evidence and initiate a comprehensive search operation. Investigators are utilizing recovered CCTV footage from the Kohat Tunnel Toll Plaza to trace the culprits and recover the stolen funds.

The incident has sparked heightened security anxieties surrounding the vital N-55 Indus Highway toll collection site. This event follows a separate counter-terrorism operation in Kohat district on November 20, 2026, where security forces killed three terrorists during a joint intelligence-based raid in the Manakara mountainous area.

stories.title: ڈرامہ درِ نجات کے نئے کرداروں کی پاکستانی سیاستدانوں سے مشابہت پر بحث
stories.summary:
ڈرامہ سیریل ’درِ نجات‘ کے نئے کرداروں بیلا اور امان نے اپنی اداکاری، مکالموں اور ظاهری حلیے کی وجہ سے ناظرین کی توجہ حاصل کر لی ہے۔ ڈرامے میں ماضی کی اقدار، فیشن اور پہناوے کو اجاگر کیا گیا ہے جس کے لیے پروڈکشن ٹیم نے مختلف فیشن ڈیزائنرز اور ریٹیل برانڈز سے ملبوسات کا انتخاب کیا۔ مرکزی اداکاروں کے ملبوسات سے متعلق مداحوں کی جانب سے سوالات بھی پوچھے گئے۔

ڈرامے کا ایک اہم کردار خوش بخت اپنی دھیمی آواز اور تحمل مزاجی کی وجہ سے مقبول ہے اور شائقین کا کہنا ہے کہ ہر ایک کو ایسی ساس ملنی چاہیے۔ ڈرامے میں خوش بخت کا ماضی دکھایا گیا ہے جہاں وہ بیلا نامی ضدی اور خوبصورت نوجوان لڑکی کے روپ میں نظر آتی ہیں۔ بیلا کا یہ کردار اداکارہ سحر ہاشمی نے ادا کیا ہے جبکہ 1990 کی دہائی پر مبنی اس فلیش بیک کہانی میں زندگی کے دردناک حالات اور قربانیوں کو پیش کیا گیا ہے۔

ابو بکر کا کردار ادا کرنے والے شہریار منور اس ڈرامے میں امان گجر کے ناپسندیدہ روپ میں بھی دکھائی دے رہے ہیں۔ ابو بکر کے مداحوں کو یہ بات پسند نہیں آئی کہ وہ ابو بکر کی شکل کے ساتھ منفی کردار ادا کریں۔ فلیش بیک مناظر میں شہریار منور نے پرانے طرز کا چشمہ، گھنی مونچھیں اور ونٹیج ملبوسات پہن رکھے ہیں جن کے کلاسیکی انداز پر سوشل میڈیا پر بحث جاری ہے۔

سوشल میڈیا صارفین نے ڈرامے کے ان کرداروں کو ماضی کے پاکستانی سیاستدانوں سے مشابہ قرار دیا ہے۔ صارفین کا ماننا ہے کہ بیلا کا ہیئر سٹائل اور ظاہری شکل و صورت جوانی کی بینظیر بھٹو سے ملتی ہے جبکہ امان گجر کی عینک اور مونچھیں آصف علی زرداری کے انداز کی ہو بہو نقل ہیں۔ کچھ نوجوان صارفین نے زرداری کی جوانی کی تصاویر دیکھ کر خوش کن حیرت کا اظہار کیا ہے۔

کچھ سوشل میڈیا صارفین کا یہ بھی خیال ہے کہ اگر کبھی آصف علی زرداری اور بینظیر بھٹو کی کوئی بائیو پک بنائی جائے تو اس کے لیے یہ ڈرامائی جوڑی بہترین کاسٹ ثابت ہوگی۔ ناقدین اور مداحوں کی جانب سے اس مشابہت کو محض اتفاق قرار دیا جا رہا ہے یا پھر یہ اس دور کا عام فیشن سمجھا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistani Leaders Discuss Governance and New Provinces Amid Local Political Tensions
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Interior Mohsin Naqvi visited senior politician and Pakistan Muslim League-Quaid (PML-Q) chief Chaudhry Shujat Hussain in Lahore on Monday to review the ongoing political climate and government law and order initiatives. Federal Minister for Overseas Pakistanis Chaudhry Salik Hussain and Provincial Minister for Industries Chaudhry Shafay Hussain also attended the meeting, where discussions focused on devolving power to the grassroots level. Chaudhry Shujat Hussain asserted that creating new provinces is vital for public facilitation, improved governance, and the nation's future, emphasizing that strengthening administrative units is essential because ordinary citizens are the primary stakeholders.

During the discussions, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi briefed the PML-Q leader on current security measures and anti-terrorism operations taking place in Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP). Naqvi stressed that aligning decisions with the public will remains a primary objective. In addition, the interior minister addressed media members informally in Lahore, criticizing an unnamed minister who he said has targeted him on television for the past two and a half years merely to gain media attention. Naqvi warned that he would severely impact that minister's public standing if he ever chose to respond.

Naqvi also defended the Pakistani business community against recent criticism, praising targeted businessmen as respectable citizens and significant contributors to the economy. He noted that many of these individuals have served as federal and local chamber of commerce presidents and rank among the nation's top taxpayers. Highlighting an apparent contradiction, Naqvi questioned why political parties routinely collect billions of rupees from these same businessmen for election funding if they view them as undesirable.

Meanwhile, legal proceedings continued in the judiciary as the Peshawar High Court (PHC) reviewed 21 missing persons cases on Monday. A high court bench consisting of Justice Ijaz Anwar evaluated reports regarding 15 petitions concerning disappeared individuals and formally returned six missing person petitions. During the court session, a petitioner shared that her son-in-law remains missing without authorities finding any trace of him.

stories.title: South Korean Shares Plunge Nearly Three Percent Amid Global Technology Selloff
stories.summary:
South Korean shares experienced a sharp decline on Monday, with the benchmark KOSPI dropping 132.98 points, or 2.73%, to close at 4,736.98 by 0034 GMT. The index hovered at its lowest level since January, as a severe global technology selloff and investor anxieties surrounding artificial intelligence trade heavily impacted regional sentiment. The downturn occurred despite authorities announcing on Sunday that market stabilisation funds would be deployed immediately if financial conditions worsened following a tumble to a 10-month low last week.

The policy pledge failed to calm market jitters, demonstrating that investors were far more concerned about the broader trajectory of global technology stocks than local measures aimed at supporting the market. This rapid selloff highlighted how quickly shifting Wall Street sentiment regarding AI-related spending can impact technology supply chains across Asia. Market participants have increasingly begun questioning whether massive capital investments in artificial intelligence will yield returns quickly enough to justify their high costs.

Negative market breadth dominated the trading session, with 810 out of 896 traded issues declining while only 68 advanced. Major index heavyweights suffered notable losses, including chipmaker Samsung Electronics falling 3.44% and rival SK Hynix dropping 2.16%. Other prominent companies also retreated, with battery manufacturer LG Energy Solution sliding 1.00%, while automaker Hyundai Motor and its sister company Kia Corp fell 3.14% and 2.95%, respectively.

Amid these sweeping equity headwinds, benchmark bond yields remained flat during early trading as investors carefully weighed domestic policy interventions against broader international pressures. The muted reaction to Seoul's intervention underscores the vulnerability of regional markets to shifts in global technology sentiment and questions surrounding the commercial viability of current AI trade trends.

stories.title: Iron Ore Prices Decline in China Amid Weakening Demand and Shrinking Margins
stories.summary:
Iron ore prices dropped on Monday, pressured by persistently declining demand and shrinking steel profit margins in China, the world's top consumer. On the Dalian Commodity Exchange, the most-traded iron ore contract fell by 0.69% to 651.5 yuan, equivalent to $97.57 per metric ton, by 0153 GMT. Concurrently, the benchmark December iron ore contract on the Singapore Exchange decreased by 0.25% to $88.25 per ton by 0143 GMT, keeping the contract well beneath the psychological threshold of $90 for five consecutive sessions.

Weak demand for the fundamental steelmaking ingredient persisted as narrow steel margins and lackluster end-user demand restricted the restocking appetite of steelmakers for raw feedstocks. Data compiled by the consultancy Mysteel showed that average daily hot metal output, which serves as a key indicator for iron ore demand, slipped for the sixth consecutive week. Output fell 0.3% from the preceding week to reach an eight-month low of 2.3 million tons as of November 19.

Profitability across the Chinese steel sector remained severely depressed. Mysteel data indicated that only about 10% of Chinese steelmakers operated at a profit as of November 19, a sharp drop compared to the 38% profitability rate recorded during the exact same period a year earlier. Despite these weak conditions, market analysts suggest that iron ore prices might eventually bottom out following a wave of steep declines because current valuations have stayed relatively low.

Other steelmaking ingredients experienced similar downward pressure, with coking coal and coke dropping by 0.86% and 0.15%, respectively. Additionally, steel benchmarks traded on the Shanghai Futures Exchange posted broad losses. Rebar decreased by 0.63%, hot-rolled coil slipped by 0.83%, and stainless steel recorded a loss of 0.84%.

stories.title: Australian and New Zealand Dollars Recover Alongside Wall Street Amid Persistent Risks
stories.summary:
The Australian dollar rebounded on Monday, rising 0.4% to $0.6645 and snapping a nine-session losing streak supported by gains in Wall Street futures. Last week, the currency had tumbled 2.3% to a low of $0.6609, its weakest level since December 22, erasing all of its gains for 2026 and leaving it down nearly 9% from a four-year peak in May. JPMorgan chief economist for Australia and NZ, Ben Jarmen, noted that higher interest rates are now negatively impacting high-yielding currencies by exacerbating growth downturns and reflecting problematic inflation.

Following five interest rate hikes this year that pushed the cash rate to an 18-year high of 4.85%, markets anticipate that the Reserve Bank of Australia has concluded its tightening cycle. This shift comes after the unemployment rate rose to a five-year high of 4.9%, with investors fully pricing in a rate cut by August and a total of 50 basis points of easing by the end of the year. Furthermore, the risk-sensitive Australian dollar has suffered from a sharp selloff in technology stocks, alongside declining prices for key national exports such as gold, copper, and iron ore.

In contrast, the New Zealand dollar held up better despite starting from a lower interest-rate background, rising 0.2% to $0.5479 on Monday after previously falling 0.9% to a 17-year low of $0.5464. Recent data showed a 2.2% jump in third-quarter retail sales, significantly beating expectations and indicating a strong consumer spending recovery. Swaps now reflect an 80% probability that the Reserve Bank of New Zealand will raise interest rates by a quarter percentage point to 3%, with a total of 90 basis points of tightening priced in by the end of next year.

Analysts at OCBC noted that the relative policy environment is becoming more favorable for the New Zealand dollar as the central bank signals that tighter policies will likely remain necessary. Additionally, lower energy prices are expected to provide New Zealand with greater terms-of-trade relief than Australia. Consequently, the Australian dollar edged up 0.2% to NZ$1.2123 on Monday, recovering slightly after losing 1.3% last week to touch its lowest level since late August.

stories.title: Trump Hosts Third Meme Coin Gala in Virginia Amid Falling Token Prices
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump hosted a private dinner for top holders of his $TRUMP meme coin at his golf club in Sterling, Virginia, on Sunday. The event marked the third time the president has held a gala for the cryptocurrency's largest investors, though attendees noted the gathering was more low-down and drew a smaller crowd than previous events. Guests at the Trump National club dined on grilled filet mignon and pan-seared halibut while listening to speeches from figures including Kevin O'Leary and Tristan Thompson.

Participants qualified for the gala based on their time-weighted holdings of the token from September 30 to November 16. Organisers indicated that 185 crypto wallets met the criteria, a sharp drop from the 220 wealthy investors who attended a previous gala in May 2025. Blockchain data analyzed by Public Citizen revealed that over half of the publicly listed wallets for Sunday's dinner belonged to crypto exchanges barring US users, suggesting foreign ownership. The $TRUMP coin once reached a peak of $75 but has since plummeted to a record low of under $1.

Despite the decline of the meme coin, Trump stated that his motive for supporting the cryptocurrency was to boost United States economic competitiveness against China. While outside investors across five main Trump-linked crypto projects have lost over $5 billion due to falling asset values, the president's financial disclosures indicate that the meme coin and other crypto ventures have earned the Trump family hundreds of millions of dollars.

The event experienced some logistical friction and controversy. Morten Christensen, a cryptocurrency platform founder who qualified for the top 29 winners, reported being denied a VIP band and was eventually ejected from the venue for allegedly sharing information with the press. Neither the White House nor the Trump Meme Coin project responded to requests for comment regarding the gala or the token's market performance.

stories.title: Thai Baht Weakens Against US Dollar in Monday Trading
stories.summary:
The Thai baht lost ground against the US dollar during Monday's trading session. Financial data from LSEG indicated that the currency traded within a range of 33.995 to 33.975.

At 0218 GMT, the baht registered a 0.15% decline, trading at 33.97 versus the dollar. This downward movement followed the previous session's close, where the currency had finished at 33.9175 per dollar.

stories.title: COP31 Climate Talks Collapse After Disagreements Over Fossil Fuel Language
stories.summary:
The COP31 climate conference in Antalya collapsed without reaching a political agreement for the first time since 2009. Negotiators from various regions, including Europe, Asia, Africa, Latin America, and small island states, blamed the breakdown on the disproportionate influence and resistance of Saudi Arabia and other oil-producing nations regarding fossil fuel reduction language.

Throughout the two-week summit, Riyadh consistently opposed any mention of oil, gas, and coal in the text while advocating for carbon capture technologies. Delegates stated that Saudi officials enjoyed regular access to the Turkish COP presidency and frequently visited its offices alongside Chinese and Russian representatives. In contrast, vulnerable nations and the European Union argued that omitting fossil fuels from the agreement ignored the primary drivers of global warming.

A coalition of approximately 130 countries, led by Germany and supported by small island states and the High Ambition Coalition, delivered a letter demanding that any final deal address the transition away from fossil fuels. However, a revised draft released by the Turkish presidency largely ignored the letter, leaving out fossil fuel references while promoting carbon capture. Ministers such as Ireland's Darragh O’Brien and Denmark's Samira Nawa criticized the heavy influence of oil-producing states.

Efforts to broker a compromise were further hindered by the absence of active US engagement and the lack of coordination between the United States and China, which had facilitated agreements at past summits. As negotiations stalled and divisions deepened, COP31 president Murat Kurum confirmed during the closing plenary that no agreement had been reached and no new text would be advanced.

stories.title: Three Bullet-Riddled Bodies Discovered Along Company Road in Bannu
stories.summary:
Police in Bannu discovered three bullet-riddled bodies on Monday within the jurisdiction of the Domel police station. The grim find was made along Company Road in tehsil Domel, prompting law enforcement officers to immediately rush to the crime scene.

The victims included two brothers, Abdul Razzaq and Sajid, also known as Jeeda, who were the sons of Rahamzada. The third slain individual was identified as Adil Nawaz, a native of Lakki Marwat who was visiting the two brothers as a guest. Following the discovery, authorities transferred all three bodies to a hospital for post-mortem examinations and other necessary medical procedures.

Police registered a triple murder case based on a formal complaint filed by a surviving brother of the two local victims. Initial reports suggest that a property dispute may have triggered the deadly shooting. Authorities have stated that an active investigation is underway, with officials examining multiple potential motives and aspects surrounding the violent incident.

stories.title: Karachi Rangers Apprehend Four Suspects Linked to Hundreds of Street Crimes
stories.summary:
Pakistan Rangers conducted an intelligence-led operation in the Memon Goth region of Karachi, resulting in the apprehension of four individuals accused of participating in numerous street crimes and robberies. The detained suspects have been identified by authorities as Zain-ul-Abideen, Shayan, Akbar, also known as Shani, and Rashid Rasheed.

During the operation, law enforcement personnel seized a substantial cache of items, including five pistols, one repeater, a 12-bore rifle with associated ammunition, cash, and 39 mobile phones that had been snatched from citizens. Preliminary inquiries indicate that the gang and their associates were tied to more than 300 unlawful acts involving armed robberies, weapon possession, and the theft of cash, motorcycles, and mobile phones across Malir and neighboring districts.

Investigators noted that Zain-ul-Abideen, Shayan, and Akbar used firearms to threaten citizens during robberies, whereas Rashid Rasheed allegedly handled the sale of the stolen mobile phones. Specific past offenses attributed to the group include the recent theft of 75,000 rupees and two mobile phones from bank employees in Gonga Goth, as well as the theft of a motorcycle, phone, and 10,000 rupees from a resident on Jam Goth Road. Furthermore, Zain-ul-Abideen is accused of utilizing a fraudulent identification card belonging to a military institution to avoid law enforcement detection, and he already faces multiple registered cases at various police stations.

The Rangers have transferred the suspects, along with the confiscated weapons and stolen property, to local police departments for further legal proceedings. Meanwhile, law enforcement agencies are actively pursuing additional raids to capture remaining members of the criminal network who remain at large.

stories.title: Renowned Australian Music Producer and Television Presenter Ian Molly Meldrum Dies at 83
stories.summary:
Ian "Molly" Meldrum, a prominent figure in the Australian music industry as a television presenter and music producer, has passed away at the age of 83 following an illness. His family confirmed the death in a public statement on Monday, marking the end of a career that helped launch and elevate the profiles of numerous local and international musicians, including iconic rock bands and singers like AC/DC and Kylie Minogue.

Meldrum gained widespread fame as the host of Countdown, a music program broadcast on the public network ABC. Over a 13-year period starting in 1974, he utilized his platform to promote various artists ranging from INXS to ABBA, famously urging viewers with his signature catchphrase to "do yourself a favour" to boost record sales. His unique interviewing style also brought him across notable international figures, such as Elton John—who once referred to him as a national treasure—and Britain’s King Charles, with whom Meldrum conducted a famously awkward interview in 1977.

Before his television career, Meldrum worked as a music journalist in London and served as a publicist for Apple Records, founded by the Beatles. Over the years, he also produced multiple musical records both prior to and after his tenure on Countdown. In 2011, he suffered severe injuries after falling from a ladder at his residence, an incident that prompted widespread concern and well-wishes from prominent figures across the entertainment industry.

Meldrum was later inducted into the ARIA Hall of Fame in 2014, where his eccentric interview style was humorously recalled by King Charles. According to the family statement released on Monday, Meldrum is survived by his partner and his adopted son.

stories.title: Armed Robbers Target Young Man in Karachi's DHA in Twenty Seconds
stories.summary:
Street crime incidents continue to draw intense public attention in Karachi following a rapid armed robbery captured on surveillance video in the Defence Housing Authority (DHA), Phase VI. Two armed perpetrators targeted a young man in the Khayaban-e-Hilal neighborhood while he was waiting outside a residence for a friend.

According to the recorded footage, the two suspects approached the victim on a motorcycle after crossing over the road divider from the opposite lane. The driver of the motorcycle immediately snatched a mobile phone from the young man's hand. When the victim attempted to speak, the suspect grabbed him by the collar while his accomplice searched the victim's pockets to steal a second mobile phone. The entire crime transpired in approximately 20 seconds, after which both individuals fled the scene by driving back across the same roadway.

This rapid daylight robbery has intensified ongoing local anxieties regarding the prevalence of street crime throughout Karachi. In response to separate political rallies and protests scheduled for the same day, law enforcement authorities heightened security measures across the city. Karachi police deployed a comprehensive contingency plan overseen in the field by Station House Officers and Deputy Superintendents of Police.

As part of these heightened security protocols, patrol vehicles were equipped with anti-riot gear while reserve units remained on standby. Authorities mandated the use of helmets, shields, and bulletproof jackets in sensitive regions, major highways, and the red zone. Police units were likewise instructed to strictly monitor entry and exit points across the urban area and maintain close surveillance on suspicious individuals.

stories.title: کراچی میں نئے صوبوں کے حق میں بڑا اجتماع منعقد کیا جائے گا، مصطفیٰ کمال
stories.summary:
متحدہ قومی موومنٹ (ایم کیو ایم) پاکستان کے رہنما مصطفیٰ کمال نے کورنگی میں کارکنوں سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ کراچی کے عوام نئے صوبوں کے حق میں ایک بڑے اجتماع میں اپنا حتمی فیصلہ سنائیں گے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ نئے صوبوں کی تحریک کا مقصد کسی قسم کے انتخابات یا نشستیں حاصل کرنا نہیں، بلکہ یہ پاکستان کی بقا اور آنے والی نسلوں کے مستقبل کی سنجیدہ جدوجہد ہے۔

مصطفیٰ کمال نے سندھ حکومت اور وفاقی نظام پر کڑی تنقید کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ اٹھارویں ترمیم کے بعد وفاق کو پہلے ہی دن مالی طور پر لاچار کر دیا گیا۔ انہوں نے الزام عائد کیا کہ ہزاروں ارب روپے وصول کرنے کے باوجود صوبائی ادارے اپنی ذمہ داریاں پوری نہیں کر رہے ہیں۔ سولہ سالوں میں 22 ہزار ارب روپے ملنے کے باوجود اندرون سندھ اور کراچی کے حالات خراب ہیں۔

انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ نئے صوبوں کے قیام سے شہریوں کو بہترین تعلیم اور روزگار کے مواقع ملیں گے۔ ان تمام کوششوں کو آئین اور قانون کے دائرے میں رہ کر پرامن طریقے سے آگے بڑھایا جا رہا ہے۔

ایم کیو ایم رہنما نے خبردار کیا کہ کچھ عناصر شہری سندھ میں لسانی بنیادوں پر خون خرابہ کرانے کی کوشش کر رہے ہیں، لیکن وہ اپنے عزائم میں کامیاب نہیں ہوں گے۔ انہوں نے اس عزم کا اعادہ کیا کہ تمام زبانیں بولنے والے شہریوں اور سندھی بھائی بہنوں کے جان و مال کا تحفظ یقینی بنایا جائے گا اور اگلے سال سے حقیقی آزادی کے دائمی عہد کا آغاز ہوگا۔

stories.title: کراچی کی آبادی کئی ملکوں سے زیادہ ہے، الگ صوبہ بننا چاہیے، سینیٹر علی ظفر
stories.summary:
پاکستان تحریکِ انصاف (پی ٹی آئی) کے سینیٹر علی ظفر نے لاہور میں میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ ملک میں ہر صورت نئے صوبے بننے چاہئیں۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ سندھ میں نئے صوبے کے قیام میں کوئی قانونی رکاوٹ نہیں ہے اور چونکہ کراچی کی آبادی کئی ملکوں سے زیادہ ہے، اس لیے اسے بھی ایک الگ صوبہ بننا چاہیے۔ اس کے علاوہ جنوبی اور شمالی پنجاب بھی نئے صوبے کے طور پر قائم ہو سکتے ہیں۔

سینیٹر علی ظفر نے واضح کیا کہ بانیٔ پی ٹی آئی بھی نئے صوبے بنانے کے حق میں ہیں۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ پارٹی کا موقف ہے کہ پہلے نئے صوبوں سے متعلق آئینی مسودہ سامنے آئے، اس کے بعد ہی پارٹی اس پر اپنا حتمی مؤقف اور فیصلہ دے گی۔ پی ٹی آئی تمام فیصلے سیاسی مشاورت کے ذریعے کرتی ہے۔

صوبے کے قیام کے طریقہ کار پر بات کرتے ہوئے علی ظفر کا کہنا تھا کہ آئین میں صوبے بنانے کا جو قانونی طریقہ درج ہے، وہی نافذ العمل ہوگا۔ ان کا مزید کہنا تھا کہ ریفرنڈم سے عوامی رائے تو معلوم کی جا سکتی ہے لیکن اس سے صوبے بنانے کے آئینی طریقہ کار میں کوئی تبدیلی نہیں آتی۔

اس بیان کے ذریعے پی ٹی آئی نے ملک میں انتظامی بنیادوں پر نئے صوبوں کی تشکیل کی حمایت کا اعادہ کیا ہے، جس سے سیاسی حلقوں میں نئی بحث چھڑ گئی ہے۔

stories.title: بہاولپور: شدید دھند کے باعث کاروں سے بھرا ہوا ٹریلر الٹ گیا
stories.summary:
بہاولپور کے نواح میں خانقاہ شریف بائی پاس کے قریب شدید دھند کے باعث کراچی سے لاہور جانے والا ایک ٹریلر الٹ گیا۔ یہ ٹریلر نئی گاڑیوں سے لدا ہوا تھا جو مختلف مقامات پر ترسیل کے لیے جا رہی تھیں۔

ریسکیو حکام کے مطابق اس حادثے کے نتیجے میں ٹریلر پر لدی ہوئی نو نئی گاڑیوں کو نقصان پہنچا ہے۔ تاہم خوش قسمتی سے اس حادثے میں کسی قسم کا جانی نقصان نہیں ہوا۔ واقعے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی امدادی ٹیمیں موقع پر پہنچ گئیں اور ٹریلر کو سیدھا کرنے کے لیے کرین طلب کر لی گئی۔

حکام نے تصدیق کی ہے کہ حادثے کی بنیادی وجہ شدید دھند تھی جس کی وجہ سے ڈرائیور کو سڑک کا واضح اندازہ نہیں ہو سکا۔ موسم کی خرابی کے باعث اس نوعیت کے حادثات سے بچنے کے لیے متعلقہ اداروں نے مسافروں اور ٹرانسپورٹرز کو محتاط رہنے کی ہدایات جاری کی ہیں۔

stories.title: گوجرانوالہ میں ادھار رقم مانگنے پر دوست کو زہر دے کر قتل کرنے والے دو ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
گوجرانوالہ کے علاقے جنڈیالہ باغوالہ میں پیش آنے والے ایک اندوہناک واقعے میں پولیس نے بوری بند لاش ملنے کے معمہ کو کامیابی سے حل کرتے ہوئے دو ملزمان کو گرفتار کر لیا ہے۔ سی پی او صہیب اشرف کی جانب سے فراہم کردہ معلومات کے مطابق مقتول کو کسی اور نے نہیں بلکہ اس کے اپنے ہی دوستوں نے موت کے گھاٹ اتارا تھا۔ پولیس نے تفتیش کے بعد انکشاف کیا ہے کہ ملزمان نے یہ ہولناک قدم اس وقت اٹھایا جب مقتول نے ان سے اپنی ادھار دی گئی رقم واپس مانگی۔ رقم کی واپسی کے تنازع پر ملزمان نے اپنے دوست کو زہر دے کر ہلاک کیا۔

دوست کو زہر دے کر مارنے کے بعد ملزمان نے شواہد چھپانے کی مذموم کوشش کی۔ انہوں نے مقتول کی لاش کو ایک بوری میں بند کیا اور اسے ایک خالی پلاٹ میں پھینک کر فرار ہو گئے۔ پولیس نے اطلاع ملنے پر فوری کارروائی کی اور شواہد اکٹھے کرکے قاتلوں تک رسائی حاصل کی۔ اس اندوہناک قتل کے کھلنے سے علاقے میں سنسنی پھیل گئی ہے اور پولیس نے دونوں ملزمان کو حراست میں لے کر مزید قانونی کارروائی کا آغاز کر دیا ہے۔

ادھار کی رقم کے تنازع پر ہونے والا یہ قتل ذاتی دشمنیوں اور مالی تنازعات کے دوران بڑھتی ہوئی عدم برداشت کی ایک اور المناک مثال ہے۔ پولیس حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ گرفتار ملزمان سے مزید تفتیش کی جا رہی ہے تاکہ اس واردات کے تمام پہلوؤں کو سامنے لایا جا سکے اور عدالت میں مضبوط چالان پیش کیا جا سکے۔ اس کارروائی سے علاقے کے شہریوں نے پولیس کی کارکردگی کو سراہا ہے جنہوں نے کم وقت میں ملزمان کو قانون کی گرفت میں لا کھڑا کیا۔

یہ واقعہ اس بات کی غمازی کرتا ہے کہ معمولی مالی معاملات اور باہمی رنجشیں کتنی خطرناک شکل اختیار کر سکتی ہیں۔ سی پی او صہیب اشرف کی زیر نگرانی پولیس ٹیم نے بروقت کارروائی کرتے ہوئے اندھے قتل کا سراغ لگایا۔ قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کا عزم ہے کہ ایسے سنگین جرائم میں ملوث عناصر کو کیفر کردار تک پہنچایا جائے گا تاکہ معاشرے میں انصاف کی فراہمی یقینی بنائی جا سکے اور آئندہ ایسے واقعات کی روک تھام کی جا سکے۔

stories.title: Indian Government Bonds Fall as Profit Booking and Rupee Drop Offset US Rally
stories.summary:
Indian government bonds reversed their early gains on Monday, pressured by profit-taking from traders and a sharp depreciation in the rupee. These factors completely offset the positive momentum initially provided by a rally in US Treasuries. The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield rose to 7.2185% by mid-morning, climbing back up after hitting an earlier low of 7.1678% following a Friday close of 7.1868%. Indian debt markets are scheduled to close on Tuesday for a local holiday.

The reversal followed a strong previous week where the 10-year bond yield dropped 12 basis points, driven by falling US yields and a strengthening rupee. However, market sentiment shifted as the rupee declined steeply toward the 93 per US dollar mark after closing at 92.67 on Friday. Meanwhile, US Treasury yields had tumbled late last week as investors sought safety from equities, recording their biggest weekly drop since early April 2025.

Additional pressure on the market came from high oil prices, with Brent crude holding near $92 a barrel due to escalating US-Iran tensions and upcoming holiday positioning. As a major importer, India faces risks of a widened current account deficit, a weaker currency, and fueled inflation from persistently high energy costs. Traders are now shifting their attention to the upcoming Reserve Bank of India policy decision on December 4, where most surveyed economists anticipate a 25 basis point repo rate hike.

stories.title: برطانیہ کا چھٹی نسل کا ٹیمپیسٹ طیارہ، آخری پائلٹ والا جنگی جہاز قرار
stories.summary:
رائل ایئر فورس کے سربراہ ایئر چیف مارشل سر ہارو سمتھ نے کہا ہے کہ گلوبل کومبیٹ ایئر پروگرام کے تحت تیار کیا جانے والا چھٹی نسل کا لڑاکا طیارہ شاید آخری ایسا جنگی طیارہ ہو گا جس میں انسانی پائلٹ موجود ہو گا۔ مستقبل میں مصنوعی ذہانت اور بغیر عملے کے خودکار طیارے عسکری ہوا بازی میں اہم کردار ادا کریں گے۔

ٹیمپیسٹ کہلانے والے اس طیارے کو برطانیہ، اٹلی اور جاپان مشترکہ طور پر تیار کر رہے ہیں، جس کے 2035 تک باضابطہ طور پر سروس میں شامل ہونے کی توقع ہے۔ اس منصوبے کے ڈیزائن کے اگلے مرحلے کے لیے رواں سال جولائی میں تینوں ممالک کے درمیان چار اعشاریہ چھ ارب پاؤنڈ کے معاہدے پر دستخط کیے گئے تھے۔

اس طیارے میں جدید ڈیٹا پروسیسنگ، مصنوعی ذہانت اور ریڈار سے بچنے کی بہتر سٹیلتھ ٹیکنالوجی استعمال کی جائے گی جو شدید دباؤ میں پائلٹ کی مدد کرے گی۔ برطانوی حکومت کے مطابق اس منصوبے سے اب تک تین ہزار پانچ سو افراد کو روزگار ملا ہے اور ایک ہزار افراد اپرنٹس شپ سے مستفید ہو رہے ہیں۔

رواں سال جولائی میں کینیڈا کو اس پروگرام میں مبصر کا درجہ دیا گیا جبکہ اکتوبر میں برطانوی وزیر اعظم اینڈی برنہم نے کہا کہ ان کی حکومت جرمنی کو بھی اس شراکت داری میں شامل کرنے کی کوشش کر رہی ہے تاکہ ہائبرڈ حملوں کا مقابلہ کیا جا سکے۔

stories.title: Maria Memon Expresses Doubt Over Justice in Fatima Asghar Torture Case
stories.summary:
Prominent anchorperson Maria Memon has voiced deep skepticism regarding the pursuit of justice in the brutal killing of 13-year-old domestic worker Fatima Asghar. Pointing to historical precedents in Pakistan, Memon expressed fear that the high-profile case involving two confessed suspects—including the wife of an FIA director and a Qari—will eventually fade from public memory without true accountability.

The tragedy gained widespread attention after disturbing video footage surfaced showing the young girl being physically assaulted and chased with a stick. Additional footage captured a domestic worker cleaning nearby seemingly unaffected by the violence, which raised troubling questions about whether such abuse had become routine in the household. A post-mortem report from the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences confirmed that Fatima suffered repeated physical torture, revealing at least 20 fresh and old wounds spanning from her head to her feet.

Memon lamented that extreme economic hardship often pushes vulnerable families to accept inadequate compensation or diyat, leading them to ultimately forgive those responsible. She questioned whether powerful individuals would face long-term consequences, suggesting the suspects could eventually be released and reinstated while the victim's family remains trapped in poverty. Police sources confirmed that both arrested suspects have confessed, and authorities have recovered a stick and an electric iron allegedly used in the brutal assault.

stories.title: UN Calls for Independent Investigation After Drones Attack Ships Off Libya
stories.summary:
The United Nations has demanded an immediate, independent, and transparent investigation following drone attacks on two ships off the coast of Benghazi, Libya. The Sunday strikes targeted a Russian vessel and a second ship sailing under a Maltese flag, in what is suspected to be a spill-over from the ongoing war in Ukraine. The UN mission in Libya stressed that the country must not become a battleground for foreign conflicts.

Authorities confirmed that all crew members involved in the strikes were safely rescued and received treatment for minor injuries. Naval and air force units in eastern Libya intercepted more than 12 explosive-laden sea drones during the incident. While eastern authorities did not directly assign blame, they noted that the attacked Russian ship was docked for refueling and resupply on its return journey to Russia. The eastern administration announced plans to conduct a joint investigation with Russia.

The latest maritime incidents follow a similar drone strike on a Russian cargo ship in the eastern Baltic Sea, which Finnish border guards attributed to Ukraine. Libya remains politically fractured between the UN-recognized government in Tripoli, led by Prime Minister Abdulhamid Dbeibah, and a rival administration in the east backed by military commander Khalifa Haftar. The Tripoli government expressed alarm over civilian ports being entangled in external conflicts, warning against any actions that could jeopardize national sovereignty.

stories.title: Fintech Startup Neem Secures ADB Ventures Funding to Expand Pakistan Infrastructure
stories.summary:
Karachi-based embedded financial wellness platform Neem has secured an undisclosed investment from ADB Ventures, the venture capital arm of the Asian Development Bank. The funding marks a major milestone in Neem's Pre-Series A funding round, which is currently about 80% funded. Founded by Vladimira Briestenska, Nadeem Shaikh, and Naeem Zamindar, the startup previously raised $3.6 million in its seed round and now serves over 70 enterprise clients across logistics, utilities, manufacturing, and retail sectors.

The newly acquired capital will be directed toward three core strategic priorities over the next 12 to 18 months. First, Neem plans to expand its core payments infrastructure and lending products across Pakistan to help businesses digitize collections, fund disbursements, and manage multi-party ledgers. Second, the startup intends to advance its regulatory licensing roadmap to broaden its financial service capabilities. Finally, the company will strengthen the security, scalability, and AI-driven automation of its technology infrastructure.

According to co-founder Vladimira Briestenska, the firm is also developing two complementary lending pillars: expanding earned wage access into a comprehensive financial wellness platform for underserved workers, and introducing merchant working capital financing based on transaction histories rather than traditional financial statements. Emma Fan, ADB Country Director for Pakistan, praised the initiative for helping local enterprises transition away from cash toward more transparent and efficient digital payment solutions.

stories.title: Punjab Launches Digital Pilgrim Assistant for Global Sikh Visitors
stories.summary:
The Punjab government has introduced a 24/7 Digital Pilgrim Assistant to support Sikh visitors arriving from around the world. Initiated under the directives of Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif, the application offers single-platform guidance covering visits to Nankana Sahib, accommodation details, and religious rituals. The tool is designed with offline access and supports seven languages, including English, Urdu, Hindi, and Punjabi, ensuring reliable and timely assistance.

This launch coincides with extensive preparations across Nankana Sahib for the 557th birth anniversary of Baba Guru Nanak, the spiritual founder of Sikhism. All seven local gurdwaras, featuring Gurdwara Janam Asthan, have been adorned with decorative lights and illuminations. Additionally, major city squares, intersections, and the motorway interchange have been brightly lit to welcome pilgrims.

The city is currently showcasing Sikh culture and traditions, with the Punjab government implementing special beautification initiatives to highlight the area's historical and regional significance. These arrangements aim to warmly host international participants attending the birth anniversary celebrations.

In a separate entertainment note mentioned during the events, Indian cricketer Sachin Tendulkar praised actor Ranveer Singh's portrayal of Kapil Dev in the film 83, expressing at the Global Peace Honours 2026 in Mumbai that Singh could easily become a good cricketer.

stories.title: Netanyahu and Eisenkot Coalitions Resume Talks for Israeli Government
stories.summary:
Delegations from the Yashar party, led by former army chief of staff Gadi Eisenkot, and caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party met at a hotel in Herzliya near Tel Aviv to resume coalition government negotiations. Following October elections that yielded no absolute majority, Eisenkot holds the mandate to form a government until December 6, with a potential 14-day extension. His 48-member bloc requires 61 lawmakers for a majority and remains internally divided on whether to ally with ultra-Orthodox parties, Arab parties, or Likud in a national unity government.

Netanyahu advocates for a national unity government featuring a premiership rotation mechanism. Such a setup could help Netanyahu maintain political shielding against ongoing corruption charges and block an independent commission of inquiry into security failures before the October 7, 2023, Hamas raid. However, Eisenkot and his ally Naftali Bennett have previously rejected serving under a cabinet led by Netanyahu.

While Yashar frames the renewed talks as a genuine effort to build the broadest possible administration, Likud has established strict conditions for participation. Likud demands an end to personal attacks against the outgoing prime minister, the exclusion of Arab parties, and shared positions on rejecting a Palestinian state, maintaining territorial control in Syria, Lebanon, and Gaza, and addressing ultra-Orthodox Jewish conscription.

If negotiations fail, Eisenkot has warned of his readiness to bypass prolonged talks by presenting an emergency national government to parliament. This alternative plan could potentially involve forming a minority government supported by core opposition parties, though right-wing allies like Avigdor Liberman strongly oppose cooperating with Arab lawmakers.

stories.title: لکی مروت میں تھانہ صدر کے قریب ریموٹ کنٹرول دھماکے سے چار اہلکار زخمی
stories.summary:
لکی مروت میں تھانہ صدر کی پولیس موبائل کے قریب ایک ریموٹ کنٹرول دھماکا پیش آیا ہے جس کے نتیجے میں چار پولیس اہلکار معمولی زخمی ہو گئے ہیں۔ پولیس حکام کے مطابق تمام زخمی اہلکاروں کو فوری طور پر اسپتال منتقل کر دیا گیا ہے جہاں انہیں ضروری طبی امداد فراہم کی جا رہی ہے۔

واقعے کے فوراً بعد قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں نے پورے علاقے کو گھیرے میں لے لیا اور ایک سرچ آپریشن کا آغاز کر دیا گیا۔ اس حملے کے نتیجے میں قریبی ریلوے ٹریک کو بھی نقصان پہنچا ہے جہاں ایک فٹ گہرا گڑھا پڑ گیا ہے، اور ریلوے حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ متاثرہ ٹریک کی بحالی کا کام مکمل ہونے میں کئی گھنٹے درکار ہوں گے۔

اس دھماکے کے بعد سکیورٹی فورسز اور ریسکیو ادارے الرٹ ہو گئے ہیں اور علاقے میں امن و امان بح رکھنے کے لیے کارروائیاں جاری ہیں۔ واقعے کی نوعیت کو دیکھتے ہوئے قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں نے تفتیش شروع کر دی ہے تاکہ حملہ آوروں کا سراغ لگایا جا سکے۔

مقامی انتظامیہ اور پولیس حکام زخمی ہونے والے اہلکاروں کی صحت پر نظر رکھے ہوئے ہیں جبکہ ٹریک کی مرمت کا کام بھی جلد شروع کیے جانے کی توقع ہے۔ علاقے میں اضافی نفری تعینات کر کے سکیورٹی کو مزید سخت کر دیا گیا ہے تا کہ کسی بھی ناخوشگوار واقعے سے دوبارہ بچا جا سکے۔

stories.title: پاکستان اور ترکیہ کے درمیان عدالتی تعاون کے فروغ کیلیے مفاہمتی یادداشت پر دستخط
stories.summary:
پاکستان اور ترکیہ کے درمیان عدالتی تعاون کو مزید فروغ دینے کے لیے دارالحکومت اسلام آباد میں ایک اہم تقریب کے دوران مفاہمتی یادداشت پر باضابطہ دستخط کیے گئے ہیں۔ اس معاہدے کا مقصد دونوں برادر ممالک کی اعلیٰ عدالتوں کے درمیان ادارہ جاتی روابط کو مضبوط بنانا اور عدالتی نظام میں باہمی تعاون کی نئی راہیں کھولنا ہے۔

اس یادداشت پر چیف جسٹس آف پاکستان یحییٰ آفریدی اور ترکیہ کے کورٹ آف کیسیشن کے صدر عمر کیرکیز نے دستخط کیے۔ تقریب کے دوران دونوں ممالک کے قومی ترانے بجائے گئے جبکہ چیف جسٹس پاکستان نے مہمانوں کا خیرمقدم کرتے ہوئے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ قانون کی حکمرانی پر پختہ یقین رکھتے ہیں اور یہ معاہدہ دونوں ملکوں کے نظام عدل کو جدید خطوط پر استوار کرے گا۔

ترکیہ کے کورٹ آف کیسیشن کے صدر عمر کرکیز نے تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے دونوں ممالک کے دیرینہ اور تاریخی برادرانہ تعلقات کو سراہا۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ باہمی اعتماد اور مشترکہ اقدار پر مبنی ان تعلقات کو مزید وسعت دینے کے لیے تجربات کا تبادلہ اور جدید ٹیکنالوجی کا استعمال انتہائی ناگزیر ہے۔

یہ معاہدہ خاص طور پر ضلعی عدلیہ کی تربیت اور مصنوعی ذہانت سمیت جدید ٹیکنالوجی کے فروغ میں معاون ثابت ہوگا۔ اس سے ای کورٹس کے ذریعے انصاف تک رسائی بہتر ہوگی اور دونوں ممالک کے نظام انصاف میں جدت آئے گی جو کہ عدالتی تعاون کو ایک نئی بلندی پر لے جائے گا۔

stories.title: امریکہ کی بندرگاہوں اور کارگو جہازوں کو روزانہ ہزاروں سائبر حملوں کا سامنا
stories.summary:
امریکہ میں بحری شعبے کو شدید سکیورٹی چیلنجز کا سامنا ہے جہاں ملک کی بندرگاہوں اور کارگو جہازوں کو روزانہ کی بنیاد پر ہزاروں سائبر حملوں کی کوششوں کا نشانہ بنایا جا رہا ہے۔ ان حملوں میں ڈیجیٹل سسٹمز، مواصلاتی نیٹ ورکس اور کارگو کی نقل و حرکت پر نظر رکھنے والے کمپیوٹر سسٹمز کو ہدف بنایا جا رہا ہے۔

ٹیکساس میں واقع پورٹ آف کارپس کرسٹی، جو خام تیل برآمد کرنے والی امریکہ کی سب سے بڑی بندرگاہ ہے اور روزانہ تقریباً 23 لاکھ بیرل خام تیل کی برآمدات سنبھالتی ہے، کو روزانہ سینکڑوں اور بعض اوقات ہزاروں سائبر حملوں کا سامنا کرنا پڑتا ہے۔ اسی طرح لاس اینجلس کی بندرگاہ نے بھی رواں سال اگست کے مہینے میں سائبر حملوں کی تقریباً 12 کروڑ کوششیں ناکام بنانے کی اطلاع دی ہے۔

امریکی کوسٹ گارڈ کے جاری کردہ اعداد و شمار کے مطابق گزشتہ برس کے دوران بحری شعبے میں مجموعی طور پر سائبر واقعات میں 17 فیصد تک کا نمایاں اضافہ ریکارڈ کیا گیا ہے۔ ان بڑھتے ہوئے خطرات نے بحری تجارت اور معاشی سرگرمیوں کو خطرات سے دوچار کر دیا ہے۔

ان روزانہ کی بنیاد پر ہونے والے سائبر حملوں کی وجہ سے امریکی حکام انتہائی چوکس ہیں اور بندرگاہوں کے ڈیجیٹل انفراسٹرکچر کو محفوظ بنانے کے لیے ہنگامی اقدامات اٹھائے جا رہے ہیں۔ بحری شعبے میں سائبر سکیورٹی کو بہتر بنانا اب حکام کے لیے ایک اہم ترجیح بن چکا ہے تاکہ تجارتی سرگرمیاں بلا تعطل جاری رہ سکیں۔

stories.title: Oman Challenges Indian Ocean Yellowfin Tuna Catch Quotas
stories.summary:
Oman has officially contested a new fishing quota framework concerning yellowfin tuna in the Indian Ocean, citing potential negative consequences for traditional fishing communities, coastal livelihoods, and the national fisheries sector. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources filed an objection against Resolution 26/01, which was adopted by the Indian Ocean Tuna Commission (IOTC) during its May 2026 meeting in the Maldives.

A central issue for Oman is the provisional annual catch limit of 25,000 tonnes established by the resolution. Although a five-year transition period is included, Omani authorities argue the cap fails to account for the substantial contributions of artisanal and small-scale operations. Thousands of citizens rely on these fisheries for their income and national food security, prompting Muscat to demand that traditional coastal catches be excluded from total allowable catch calculations.

In tandem with its formal objection, Oman is refining its national fisheries data collection methods, encompassing catch recording, monitoring, sampling, and reporting. These enhancements led to a downward revision of estimated 2025 artisanal and coastal yellowfin tuna catches to approximately 20,000 tonnes. Industrial fishing fleets will continue to face strict supervision and national catch limits.

Oman clarified that its challenge does not permit unrestricted fishing; operators must still adhere to existing requirements under IOTC Resolution 19/01 and national regulations. The nation remains committed to collaborating with the IOTC to foster transparent, sustainable fishing regulations that balance marine conservation with economic needs under Oman Vision 2040.

stories.title: Sindh Rejects Wapda's Ghotki Drainage Project Over Water Safety
stories.summary:
The Sindh irrigation department and the Nara Canal Area Water Board have rejected a proposed Rs156 billion drainage project put forward by the Water and Power Development Authority (Wapda). The Ghotki Drainage Project aims to drain wastewater from Ubauro, Daharki, Khangarh, and Mirpur Mathelo into the Nara Canal, Sindh's largest freshwater perennial canal. Local authorities fear the scheme will contaminate freshwater supplies, degrade soil, and harm drinking water systems for millions of residents.

The project involves a 1,067-kilometer main drain intended to manage agricultural runoff and prevent waterlogging and salinisation in fertile lands. However, Sindh officials heavily criticized the Environmental Impact Assessment, stating it was conducted without consulting local stakeholders, the irrigation department, or the Nara Canal Area Water Board, in violation of the Sindh Water Management Ordinance 2002.

Opposition to the project is deeply rooted in past federal drainage failures, specifically the Left Bank Outfall Drain and Right Bank Outfall Drain networks. Officials noted that past projects caused severe ecological damage, including the destruction of Manchhar Lake and economic ruin for local fishing and farming communities due to design flaws and blocked natural waterways.

Sindh authorities emphasized that the Nara Canal serves as a vital water source for roughly 6.61 million people across multiple districts, the Thar desert, and regional power plants. Because more than half of the proposed catchment area extends outside the Ghotki canal command zone into Punjab, the province firmly maintains that discharging effluent into the Nara Canal is unacceptable.

stories.title: روسی خبر رساں ادارے اسپٹنک نے اردو نیوز سروس کا باقاعدہ آغاز کر دیا
stories.summary:
روس کے معروف خبر رساں ادارے اسپٹنک نے باضابطہ طور پر اپنی اردو نیوز سروس کا آغاز کر دیا ہے، جو پاکستان اور روس کے درمیان میڈیا کے شعبے میں ایک بڑی پیش رفت ہے۔ اسپٹنک اردو زبان میں باقاعدہ نیوز سروس شروع کرنے والا پہلا روسی خبر رساں ادارہ بن گیا ہے، جسے قومی زبان اردو کی عالمی سطح پر بڑھती ہوئی اہمیت کا اعتراف قرار دیا جا رہا ہے۔

وفاقی وزیر اطلاعات و نشریات عطاء اللہ تارڑ نے اس موقع پر اپنے ایک خصوصی ویڈیو پیغام میں ادارے کی انتظامیہ اور پوری ٹیم کو دلی مبارکباد دی۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ یہ اردو سروس پاکستان اور روس کے عوام کو قریب لانے، باہمی اعتماد، عوامی روابط اور فہم و فراست کو فروغ دینے میں انتہائی اہم اور کلیدی کردار ادا کرے گی۔

اس سروس کے آغاز کے موقع پر ماسکو میں روس میں پاکستان کے سفیر فیصل نیاز ترمذی کا پہلا خصوصی انٹرویو بھی ریکارڈ کیا گیا، جو انہوں نے ماسکو اسٹوڈیو میں اردو زبان میں دیا۔ سفیر پاکستان نے اپنے انٹرویو میں پاک روس تعلقات کی اہمیت اور دونوں ممالک کے درمیان میڈیا کے باہمی روابط کو اجاگر کیا۔

واضح رہے کہ اسپٹنک دنیا بھر میں تیس سے زائد زبانوں میں خبریں فراہم کرتا ہے اور اس کے یورپ، ایشیا، افریقہ، لاطینی امریکہ اور مشرق وسطیٰ میں چھبیس ادارتی مراکز قائم ہیں۔ وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کے متوقع دورہ روس سے قبل اس اردو سروس کا آغاز دوطرفہ تعلقات کو مزید مستحکم کرنے میں مددگار ثابت ہوگا۔

stories.title: وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کے دورۂ روس میں اہم معاہدوں کا امکان
stories.summary:
وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کے متوقع دورۂ روس کے دوران پاکستان اور روس کے مابین مختلف شعبوں میں پندرہ سے سولہ معاہدوں پر دستخط کیے جانے کا قوی امکان ہے۔ ان مجوزہ معاہدوں کا بنیادی مقصد دونوں ممالک کے باہمی تعلقات کو فروغ دینا اور دوطرفہ تعاون کو نئی وسعت عطا کرنا ہے۔ یہ دورہ دونوں ملکوں کے درمیان سفارتی اور معاشی تعلقات کے حوالے سے انتہائی اہمیت کا حامل سمجھا جا رہا ہے۔

روس میں پاکستان کے تعینات سفیر فیصل نیاز ترمذی نے مقامی میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیراعظم کے اس دورے کو ایک اہم اور تاریخی قدم قرار دیا ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ اس دورے کا مقصد دونوں ریاستوں کے باہمی تعلقات کو مزید مضبوط بنانا ہے۔ سفیر کے مطابق وزیر اعظم شہباز شریف کی ترجیحات میں سیاسی تعلقات کے فروغ کے ساتھ ساتھ تجارت، ثقافت، تعلیم اور عوامی سطح پر رابطوں کو بہتر بنانا بھی شامل ہے۔

 طے شدہ شیڈول کے مطابق وزیراعظم شہباز شریف تیس نومبر سے تین روزہ سرکاری دورے پر روس روانہ ہوں گے۔ اس دورے کے دوران توانائی کے شعبے میں تعاون بڑھانے اور سرمایہ کاری کے معاملات کو آگے بڑھانے پر خصوصی توجہ دی جائے گی تاکہ دونوں ملکوں کے معاشی روابط کو مزید استحکام مل سکے۔

یہ دورہ دونوں ممالک کے درمیان دوطرفہ تجارت، توانائی اور سرمایہ کاری کے شعبوں میں بڑی پیش رفت کا باعث بنے گا اور اس سے باہمی تعاون کے نئے دروازے کھلیں گے۔ ان معاہدوں کے ذریعے مختلف شعبوں میں تعاون کے دائرہ کار کو وسیع کیا جائے گا جس سے دونوں ممالک کے عوام کو براہ راست فائدہ پہنچے گا۔

stories.title: Pakistan Stocks Surge as KSE-100 Gains Nearly 600 Points
stories.summary:
Buying interest lifted the Pakistan Stock Exchange at the start of trading on Monday, pushing the benchmark KSE-100 Index up by nearly 600 points during the opening minutes. At 9:35 am, the index hovered at 177,974.15, marking an increase of 591.58 points or 0.33%. This positive momentum included buying activity across key sectors such as commercial banks, automobile assemblers, fertilizer, power generation, oil and gas exploration companies, and oil marketing companies. Prominent index-heavy stocks like HUBCO, PSO, MARI, OGDC, PPL, POL, HBL, MCB, and MEBL all traded in positive territory.

This rebound follows a marginally lower close the previous week, where domestic political uncertainty regarding a proposed referendum on creating new provinces dampened investor sentiment. That local pressure had counteracted the positive effects of softer international oil prices and lower domestic fuel costs, ultimately causing the KSE-100 Index to drop 491.32 points to settle at 177,382.56 points.

Globally, markets experienced turbulence last week, driven by a sharp sell-off in technology and chip stocks at the core of the artificial intelligence boom. Investors began questioning whether massive, mostly borrowed expenditures on data centers would yield returns quickly enough to satisfy lenders and justify lofty stock valuations. Consequently, the Nasdaq suffered a 10% drop—its largest weekly decline since March 2020—while Taiwan’s benchmark experienced its steepest fall since 1990.

In response to these international declines, authorities worked to stabilize Asian markets, while US stock futures rose on Monday. Early trading saw Nasdaq 100 futures bounce by nearly 3% and S&P 500 futures climb 2%. Meanwhile, Taiwan stocks steadied, and South Korean shares hit a 10-month low before finding support.

stories.title: ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کا دعویٰ: ایران نے ایک ہفتے میں سب سے زیادہ ڈرونز داغے
stories.summary:
امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ ایران نے صرف گزشتہ ایک ہفتے کے دوران پچھلے ایک سال کے مقابلے میں سب سے زیادہ حملہ آور ڈرونز اور میزائل داغے ہیں۔ انہوں نے اس دعوے کے لیے کسی رپورٹ یا اعداد و شمار کے ماخذ کا ذکر نہیں کیا، تاہم اسے کانگریس کے انتخابات میں ڈেমوکریٹس کی کامیابی اور امریکی شیئر بازاروں کی گراوٹ سے جوڑا۔

دوسری جانب برطانوی میری ٹائم ٹریڈ آپریشنز سینٹر نے بتایا کہ 19 سے 21 نومبر کے دوران امریکی مدد سے 114 جہازوں نے آبنائے ہرمز عبور کی، جو گزشتہ سال کے روزانہ اوسط 138 جہازوں سے کم ہے۔ اسی عرصے میں آبنائے باب المندب سے 68 جہاز گزرے۔ دریں اثنا، امریکی وزارت خارجہ نے بحرین میں موجود امریکی شہریوں کو حوثی حملوں کے خطرات کے پیش نظر زیادہ احتیاط برتنے کی وارننگ دی ہے۔

اسرائیل میں سیاسی صورتحال کے حوالے سے، وزیرِ اعظم بنیامن نیتن یاہو اور یاشار پارٹی کے رہنما گادی آئزنکوٹ کے درمیان اتحادی حکومت کی تشکیل پر ہونے والے مذاکرات کا دوسرا دور بھی بغیر کسی معاہدے کے ختم ہو گیا۔ اکتوبر کے انتخابات میں کسی کو واضح اکثریت نہیں ملی تھی اور سابق فوجی سربراہ گادی آئزنکوٹ کے پاس 6 دسمبر تک حکومت بنانے کا وقت ہے۔

امریکہ میں شمالی کیرولائنا کے انتخابات میں ایک اور ڈیموکریٹ کی کامیابی کے بعد ایوان نمائندگان میں ڈেমوکریٹس کی نشستیں 258 ہو گئی ہیں، جو 1992 کے بعد سب سے بڑی اکثریت ہے۔ صدر ٹرمپ نے اپنے بیان میں کہا کہ ایران کے رہنما ڈیموکریٹس کو کمزور سمجھتے ہیں لیکن وہ ایسا نہیں ہونے دیں گے۔

stories.title: Mian Muhammad Mansha Urges Structural Reforms and Cheaper Energy
stories.summary:
Mian Muhammad Mansha, chairman of Nishat Group and MCB Bank, has emphasized the need for structural reforms, including a smaller government size, lower energy expenses, eliminated bureaucratic hurdles, and upgraded infrastructure to stimulate private investment and employment in Pakistan. Speaking with B&F, he pointed out that excessive overhead, regulatory delays, and an inefficient business climate hinder corporate expansion and job creation.

Drawing parallels to the past privatization of MCB Bank, where 50,000 employees accepted golden handshakes and redirected payouts into new enterprises like schools and restaurants, Mansha argued that public sector downsizing liberates resources for productive economic activities. He also underscored severe infrastructure challenges, particularly at Karachi port, citing high operational costs, inefficient procedures, traffic congestion on route to Punjab, and an unused berth at the former Pakistan Steel Mills left idle for two decades. Furthermore, he noted that transferring terminal operations to foreign private operators doubled port charges without driving new investments.

Bureaucratic bottlenecks remain a significant obstacle, illustrated by a four-month delay his cement company faced simply to secure routine permits for importing free municipal waste from Britain, Denmark, and Italy as alternative fuel. Additionally, soaring electricity tariffs are driving industries away from the national grid toward solar power and battery storage. Mansha warned that declining grid demand could strand costly generation capacity while prompting regulators to restrict solar power instead of fixing underlying sectoral inefficiencies.

To restore industrial competitiveness, Mansha advocated for supporting labor-intensive manufacturing sectors like textiles and garments, reducing the tax burden, and establishing efficient rail freight. He also encouraged expanding regional trade with India, Afghanistan, and Central Asian nations to bolster exports, tourism, and hospitality.

stories.title: Lahore Ranks Well in Safety Index Amid Police Efficiency Reviews
stories.summary:
Lahore achieved favorable standing in Numbeo’s 2026 Mid-Year Crime and Safety Index, scoring ahead of major global cities such as New York, Paris, and New Delhi, though ranking below Islamabad. Presented to Punjab Inspector General of Police Abdul Kareem during his visit to Lahore Police Lines at Qilla Gujjar Singh, the report revealed safety and crime indexes of 63.8 and 36.2, respectively. The high-level meeting included Capital City Police Officer Bilal Siddique Kamyana, DIGs Faisal Kamran and Zeshan Raza, alongside other senior officials.

During the briefing, DIG Kamran noted that Lahore’s crime index placed it in the "Low" to "Moderate" range, outperforming Karachi and Rawalpindi. CCPO Kamyana reported that Lahore is the only city in Punjab free of no-go zones, major land-grabbing mafias, or gangsters, reflecting significant security improvements over the past four years. The discussion also addressed administrative concerns, including SHO posting criteria, missing women cases where fewer than 100 remain untraced, and a shortage of Dolphin Force motorcycles.

IGP Abdul Kareem expressed strong dissatisfaction with the deteriorating emergency response time on helpline 15 calls, which dropped to 22% across the province as callers were frequently told to visit police stations. Although Lahore's response time stood at a higher 66%, the IGP deemed it insufficient given the city's abundant resources. To address the shortage of Dolphin Force bikes, which currently rely on makeshift patrols using various station motorcycles, Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz approved a Rs300 million procurement plan to deliver 300 to 400 new bikes to Lahore Police by December.

The meeting additionally touched upon internal personnel matters, noting complaints from inspectors who felt overlooked for SHO positions in favor of sub-inspectors, a practice the DIG operations defended as a way to cultivate trained personnel for sensitive assignments.

stories.title: US Stock Futures Bounce as Global Markets Recover from AI Rout
stories.summary:
United States stock futures rose on Monday while international officials attempted to stabilize falling markets across Asia following a severe downturn for the technology and semiconductor sectors tied to the artificial intelligence boom. Investors have grown concerned that massive, largely borrowed expenditures on data centres will fail to generate returns quickly enough to satisfy lenders or justify lofty valuations. Last week, the Nasdaq suffered a 10% drop, marking its largest weekly decline since March 2020 during the pandemic panic, while Taiwan experienced its steepest fall since 1990 due to its crucial role as a semiconductor supply chain hub.

During early trading on Monday, Nasdaq 100 futures rebounded by nearly 3% and S&P 500 futures increased by 2%. Markets in Taiwan steadied, whereas South Korean shares dropped about 4% to reach a 10-month low prior to finding support. South Korea's finance minister planned to hold a press conference regarding a potential market stabilization fund to halt further declines. Japanese markets remained closed for a holiday, though futures indicated ongoing selling pressure, and markets in Hong Kong and China retreated to new multi-month lows.

The broader "AI trade," which previously boosted various sectors including cable makers and electricity generators, has faced mounting pressure from rising interest rates.
